patch_name: Utage Army Father Route V3 Cumulative
purpose: Correct the father/controller routing mistake that made V1/V2 English common/pl_face child edits invisible at runtime.
proven_root_cause: The previous patches changed rom/eng/common/pl_face child ARCs, but both current title_id.arc and common/pl_face/pl_all.arc still contain 31 external child-owner entries named rom\jpn\common\pl_face\pl000..pl029/pl_random.

For Nobunaga, the actual faction texture is army_022_ID_HQ (not army_026). The V3 English pl015 child contains the English payload SHA-256 6ff7a4cb..., while the untouched JPN pl015 child contains the Japanese payload SHA-256 e39f99e2....
Therefore a father that requests rom\jpn\common\pl_face\pl015 can reintroduce the Japanese army_022 even when rom/eng/pl015 is fully translated.
army_026 was separately decoded and corresponds to Matsunaga’s Forces / 松永軍; the prior Nobunaga=army_026 identity assumption was wrong.

route_fix.method: Fixed-size ARC table name edit only; jpn and eng are same length. No payload blobs, offsets, sizes, flags, entry ordering, or SCRA bodies changed.

cumulative_content: Includes the V2 common/pl_face synchronization set, but fixes the father route so those English child packages can actually be requested. Adds current live title_id.arc with only its 31 pl_face route names changed.
test: Fully exit RPCS3, clear relevant cache if used, merge PS3_GAME, cold boot, then check Nobunaga in Unification character select and Gallery. If the father-route hypothesis is correct, 織田軍 should be replaced by the English army_022 presentation. Stage-select 自由合戦 / 合戦 are a separate owner family and are not claimed fixed by this patch.
